description: K₃NaTi₂(SiO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.93 Å. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.54 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.92 Å) and three longer (2.10 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-35°. There are two shorter (1.64 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent K, one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing OK₂NaTiSi trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent K, one Ti, and one Si atom.
